experiment_template.research_question: Does the same paging fix replicate across windows and variants?
stop_conditions: Complete all semantic/schema outcomes; stop on infrastructure failure or drift.
No source drift, retries, replacement rows or budget expansion.

success_criteria.exposure_parameters: Prospective extrapolation from observed 8K pressure. No claim of prior 10K/12K calibration. No-exposure is a failed recovery endpoint.
success_criteria.threshold_rule: Every dispatched projected bound < configured soft limit -256

falsifier: Fewer than three net paired wins over 12 pairs, a negative net semantic comparison, or an unsafe dispatch falsifies the proposed useful improvement. Individual failures remain evidence and do not trigger replacement trials.
mechanism: H13 recycled and recovered but omitted a required envelope field and copied a boundary defect. A final general contract check may redirect attention from copying inspected source to verifying all declared behavioral and structural requirements.
scope: 24-row prospective replication, two ordered repetitions per variant/window; synthetic pressure, two variants of one family; not natural-task or broad GLM qualification.
statement: An explicit final review against the entire inspected behavioral contract and offered output schema improves initial recovery-qualified correctness over the same byte-bounded pager without that review.
